First inspection from \"Mixed\"-labeled envelope reveals its true type (say, Increasing)\n2. Choose any remaining envelope (all are uncertain: could be pure or mixed)\n3. Inspect repeatedly from that envelope:\n   - If see 2 different types → it's mixed, done with this envelope\n   - If see 14 identical types → must be pure (mixed only has 13 max of one type)\n4. Both satisfy all constraints (all labels wrong, proper mixed composition)\n  2. Produce IDENTICAL observations for first 14 inspections\n  3. Require DIFFERENT final labelings\n\n**Example valid construction:**\n- Configuration A: \"Constant\" label → pure Increasing; inspect it 14 times, all Increasing\n- Configuration B: \"Constant\"
